Hi Tommy,

Thank you for confirming, and for your patience through all of this.

Your acceptance of the Hammer Miner BC04 (6 TH/s) is recorded on your order, along with the shipping address exactly as you wrote it: (address hidden), (address hidden), Israel. Nothing else is needed from you, and you do not need to send the BS-1 back. Please keep it disconnected and do not power it on again.

The B.04 is on the shelf, so there is no wait on stock. Releasing it on a claim settled without a return has to be done by a colleague rather than by me, and I have put it in front of them now, during our working hours today. The moment it is dispatched you get the tracking number in this same thread.

If anything changes on my side before then, I will write to you here rather than leave you waiting.

Best regards,
Sarah
